fieldNotes.location: Roster coords (33.86701,-84.188105) and the roster address '3700 Mountain Industrial Blvd' were both wrong - that point is ~6km NE in a commercial/residential area. The real plant is 3367 Montreal Industrial Way, Tucker GA 30084, confirmed via Hormel/Waze/FSIS listings and a Street View sign reading 'ATLANTA PLANT'. Locked center ~33.8393,-84.2506.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Property has a perimeter chain-link fence, but the truck driveways from Montreal Industrial Way and the east road appear to be open driveway gaps without barrier arms or a guard booth. No controlled checkpoint identified - marked false at medium confidence (Street View coverage does not reach the dock-yard entrance directly).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth identified at any truck entrance. A small structure seen near a driveway appears to be a utility/picnic structure beside employee parking, not a gate booth.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: East dock face shows ~14-16 trailers backed in; additional dock doors on other faces. Total estimated 25-50 band (~28). Roof imagery overexposed - estimate.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Trailer drop yard along the east property edge (~8-12 trailers) plus trailers staged along Montreal Industrial Way. dropArea 10-25 band.
fieldNotes.truckGateCount: Two driveway access points (off Montreal Industrial Way and the east perimeter road); neither is a controlled gate.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the SE edge beyond the property's tree buffer but no spur enters the site. Not rail-served.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Tucker, GA is part of the Atlanta metro (DeKalb County) - dense industrial/commercial fabric. Urban.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: The plant is a single large connected processing complex (built 1969). Adjacent large buildings are separate companies' warehouses, not part of this facility.
fieldNotes.operations: Plant runs Hormel chili and Dinty Moore stew; the precooked bacon line was closed in 2025 with 135 of ~350 employees laid off (Aug 2025) - operations reduced.

citations.claim: Hormel Our Locations lists the Atlanta Plant in Tucker GA, 400 team members, chili and Dinty Moore stew.
Hormel discontinued only the bacon line at Tucker (135 layoffs Oct 2025); facility continues operating with 400 employees.

verification.rationale: Hormel locator lists Tucker GA as a current operating location; Aug 2025 bacon-line layoff was single-line, facility explicitly continues operating.
